verdict.rationale: Token2 makes FIDO2/PIV/TOTP hardware security keys and local, open-source management tools, and nothing in the evidence shows an AI service or AI-training data pipeline that an opt-out could apply to. AI-training opt-out is therefore a category error for this kind of product. The note that TOTP computation happens locally is a general privacy behavior, not an AI-training control, so it does not make the axis applicable.
